results.action: Open 6 protected pages (suppliers, products, transactions, 2 reports, low stock) while logged out
results.expected: Every page redirects (302) to the login page

results.action: Open /health/ while logged out
results.expected: HTTP 200 and {"status": "ok"}, no data

results.action: Log in as Administrator (admin)
results.expected: Redirect to the dashboard (302 to /)

results.action: Add supplier "Zenith Distributors d5a71b"
results.expected: Redirect to list; supplier shown as Active

results.action: Edit the supplier contact
results.expected: Redirect to list; new contact shown

results.action: Add a second supplier with the same name in capitals
results.expected: Rejected: "already exists", page stays on the form (200)

results.action: Add a supplier with a blank name
results.expected: Rejected (200), nothing saved

results.action: Set-up: create a category and two products (thresholds 5 and 2)
results.expected: Both products appear in the catalog

results.action: Stock-in 10 x Alpha from Zenith
results.expected: Redirect to transactions; list shows the supplier name

results.action: Stock-in with NO supplier chosen
results.expected: Rejected (200), no transaction saved

results.action: Open the supplier page for Zenith
results.expected: Shows the Alpha stock-in of 10

results.action: Sell 5 so stock (5) EQUALS the threshold (5)
results.expected: Alpha is NOT in the low-stock list

results.action: Sell 1 more so stock (4) is BELOW the threshold (5)
results.expected: Alpha is in the low-stock list and on the dashboard

results.action: Try to sell 99 when only 4 are in stock
results.expected: Rejected (200), stock unchanged

results.action: Restock 20 so stock (24) is above the threshold
results.expected: Alpha disappears from the low-stock list

results.action: Disable supplier Orbit, then open the stock-in form
results.expected: Orbit is no longer offered; supplier still in the list as Disabled

results.action: Open the disable URL with GET (not POST)
results.expected: HTTP 405, nothing changes

results.action: Open the stock/sales report (default last 30 days)
results.expected: Sales table and totals shown; both products listed

results.action: Export the sales CSV for today and add up our two products
results.expected: Header as specified; Alpha 6 units = 1500.00; Beta 35 units = 3500.00
results.actual: HTTP 200; text/csv; Alpha 6 units = 1500.00; Beta 35 units = 3500.00

results.action: Export the stock CSV and check stock value = quantity x price
Ask for a range where the start date is after the end date
results.expected: Error message, no report (200)

results.action: Ask for a month with no sales (January 2020)
results.expected: "No sales in this date range." and 0 units

results.action: Open top-selling products
results.expected: Beta (35 units) is ranked above Alpha (6 units)

results.action: Log in as Staff (staff1)
results.expected: Redirect to the dashboard

results.action: As Staff open suppliers, supplier page, sales report, top sellers
results.expected: All four show 403 Forbidden

results.action: As Staff open the low-stock list
results.expected: HTTP 200 (visible to Staff and Administrator)

results.action: As Staff record a stock-out; check Staff only see their own transactions
results.expected: Sale accepted; list shows own sale but not the administrator's Zenith stock-in

results.action: Poll /health/ once a second for 120 seconds
results.expected: 100% of checks HTTP 200 (target 99% of business hours)
results.actual: 119/119 checks = 100.00% available; latency median 10.7 ms, 95th percentile 15.0 ms
